title: @rethunk/mcp-multi-root-git: git_diff_summary
description: Parameter schema for the 'git_diff_summary' MCP tool.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

base.description: Base ref (e.g. "main"). Ancestor notation is accepted (e.g. "HEAD~3", "main^2"). Omit for unstaged changes.

head.description: Head ref (e.g. "feature-branch"). Ancestor notation is accepted (e.g. "HEAD~3", "main^2"). Defaults to HEAD. Used only when `base` is set.

staged.description: Show staged changes (`git diff --staged`). Ignored if `base` is set.

findCopies.description: Detect copies from other files (`git diff -C`), alongside default rename detection.

fileFilter.description: Glob pattern to restrict output to matching files, e.g. "*.ts", "src/**".

maxLinesPerFile.description: Max diff lines to include per file. Default: 50.

maxFiles.description: Max files to include in output. Default: 30.

excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude. Default: lock files, dist, vendor, etc.
